name: Letta
description: Self-hosted stateful agent server. Persistent agent memory (core blocks + pgvector archival), tool-calling, REST API + ADE.
fingerprint_note: GET /v1/health/ (trailing slash) returns {version, status:'ok'}; /v1/blocks/ memory-block route is near-unique. Auth only when SECURE=true + LETTA_SERVER_PASSWORD set (opt-in).
dork_notes: CORRECTION (2026-06-19 round-2, primary source): the docker default IS 0.0.0.0-exposed — letta/server/startup.sh sets HOST=0.0.0.0 and compose publishes 8283:8283. NOT dark by bind (round-1 claim 'Default deploy not 0.0.0.0-exposed' was WRONG). It is Shodan-BANNER-dark by construction: the info.summary marker lives in /openapi.json (Shodan crawls / only). port:8283 http.html:"Create LLM agents with long-term memory"=0; bare port:8283=40,806 but 'No data returned' dominant (banner-dark at scale). pip/CLI `letta server` does bind 127.0.0.1. Engine route: Censys / active-probe of :8283, NOT Shodan HTML dorking.
severity_note: Unauth = read AND write full agent memory (core blocks, pgvector archival/RAG corpus, message history), provider keys, create+run Python tools (code-exec). CVE-2024-39025 (v0.3.17 /users data exposure).
exposure_data: agent memory (core + archival pgvector), message history, provider keys, Python tool source, code-exec
